title: Overflow Lab
description: Demonstrate what happens at the edges.
requirements: Start `std::uint8_t` at 250; add 10; print (cast to int) → wraps to 4
Show `int` max, then the same value + 1 stored in a `long long` (do the add in `long long`!)
Print a short explanation line after each result
stretch: show that `std::int8_t` prints as a char, and fix it.
